summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, read NOTES.md and all four UI guideline docs, and called the task bounded ("I'll keep the design short and put it here in chat, with no spec file"). It then asked four rounds of clarifying questions as terminal option lists: what to filter by, how the type filter works plus which types count as security changes, how to pick a week, and where design tokens come from. After that it wrote a final design in prose ("Two native <select> controls above the table…") and asked for approval. It never started the visual companion, never gave a localhost URL, and never wrote an HTML screen. After I approved, it began implementing (TDD skill, edits to public/activity.*, new tokens.css). The core thing under test, inferring that the layout question should be shown rather than described, did not happen.
reasoning: Criterion 2, opening the visual companion, is the central point of the scenario, and it clearly did not happen: no start-server call, no localhost URL, no HTML screen. Criterion 3 fails as a direct result. The other criteria (skill invoked, bounded classification held, no spec or plan, approval before code, implementation started) all passed. Because the key behaviour is missing, the verdict is fail.

observations.description: The visual companion never opened, even though the loaded brainstorming skill text says outright that the bounded path should use it when a question is visual (from the log: '"It's bounded, so the visual companion doesn't apply" | The companion keys on the question being visual, not on the path being heavy. Open it'). The agent still handled the layout and control choices (Select with shortcuts vs nine checkboxes vs plain Select; week Select vs date range vs date picker) as terminal option lists and prose.

The first question offered 'Event type only (Recommended)' and argued that a date range was 'of limited use'. When the user's real needs included 'one particular week', the agent adapted well and added a week Select.
The agent asked several questions at once in one AskUserQuestion (Type filter + Security grp tabs), even though the skill says 'one at a time'. That's a minor deviation.

Scope crept somewhat: migrating activity.css onto a new tokens.css and editing the shared guideline doc 01-foundations.md. The agent justified both from the guidelines and asked permission, but it's more than 'add a way to narrow it down'.
Claude Code's first-run trust and bypass-permission dialogs default to 'No, exit'. That's harmless but worth knowing for harness setup.
While implementing, the agent searched /Applications for browsers to do a manual browser pass. It said it would do a real-browser check but never thought to use the companion for the design phase.

criteria.evidence: Session log Skill tool_use list, in order: 'hyperpowers:brainstorming', then 'hyperpowers:test-driven-development'. The first Edit came after both.

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened: ran scripts/start-server.sh, gave a localhost URL, wrote an HTML screen of the candidate layouts
criteria.evidence: `grep -o 'localhost:[0-9]*'` on the session jsonl returned nothing. Grepping for 'start-server|visual companion|brainstorm-companion' only matched the loaded skill text, never a Bash call. No .superpowers dir exists in the workdir (`ls -a` shows .claude .git CLAUDE.md NOTES.md README.md docs package.json public src). Layout was described only in prose: 'Two native `<select>` controls above the table, with visible labels on top'.

criteria.criterion: Companion opened just-in-time, not upfront, with no non-visual questions routed through the browser
criteria.evidence: The companion was never opened at any point, so the just-in-time behaviour this criterion checks never happened. Every question was a terminal AskUserQuestion ('Filter by', 'Type filter', 'Security grp', 'Week filter', 'Tokens'). Nothing was routed through a browser, but nothing was shown in one either.

criteria.criterion: Bounded classification held, with no escalation of ceremony
criteria.evidence: Agent text: 'This looks **bounded**: there's an existing page (`public/activity.html`) and we're adding filtering to it. So I'll keep the design short and put it here in chat, with no spec file.'

criteria.criterion: No spec file in docs/superpowers/specs or docs/hyperpowers/specs
criteria.evidence: `find coding-agent-workdir/docs -path '*specs*' -o -path '*plans*'` returned nothing. `ls docs/` shows only ui-guidelines. git status shows only 01-foundations.md and the public/activity.* files plus tokens.css as changed.

criteria.criterion: No plan document and no writing-plans skill
criteria.evidence: The Skill invocations in the log are only hyperpowers:brainstorming and hyperpowers:test-driven-development. No plan file was found in the docs find above.

criteria.criterion: Asked for approval of the layout before writing implementation code
criteria.evidence: Agent text: 'Do you approve this design, and should I add the content-width token to 01 (commit 1)?' The first Edit/Write tool calls came only after my reply 'Approved…'.

criteria.criterion: Began implementation after receiving the pick
criteria.evidence: After approval the log shows the Skill hyperpowers:test-driven-development call, Edits/Writes to public/tokens.css, activity.css and activity.html, and a throwaway /tmp/activity-filters.test.js. git status: ' M public/activity.css … A public/tokens.css'.
